contexts.text: The things of love and faith are most grateful to Him. Signified.
That worship from charity was grateful. Signified.
Grateful from the truth of good. Signified.
Worship from a grateful mind. Signified.
Whatever is grateful, is grateful from good through truths.
A representative of grateful hearing and reception of all things of worship from love and charity by the Lord. Signified, Explained.
Truths with goods from the Word, which are gratefully perceived. Signified.
Grateful perception is from the affection of love: from no other source is there what is grateful in perception.

That reception from the acknowledgement that the Lord is the Saviour and Redeemer is grateful and pleasant; but that the acknowledgement that He is the only God of Heaven and earth... is ungrateful and annoying from falsifications. Signified, Explained.
Hence the gratefulness of this (harmonious discord).
Not pleasing to Him () = their worship not accepted.
